title: An Information-Theoretic Analysis of Information Hiding in Semantic Communication
abstract: arXiv:2611.34550v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic communication shifts the transmission goal from the accurate recovery of syntactic symbols to the reliable conveyance of semantic content, yet a systematic information-theoretic characterization of information hiding at the semantic layer is still missing. Building on the semantic information theory of Niu-Zhang and the classical information hiding theory of Moulin-O'Sullivan, this paper establishes an information-theoretic framework for information hiding under semantic communication. translated_title: 语义通信中信息隐藏的信息论分析
translated_abstract: 语义通信将传输目标从语法符号的精确恢复转向语义内容的可靠传递，然而在语义层面，信息隐藏的系统化信息论刻画仍然缺失。本文基于牛-张的语义信息理论与Moulin-O'Sullivan的经典信息隐藏理论，建立了语义通信下信息隐藏的信息论框架。经典隐藏模型被扩展为双层结构（语义宿主、语法宿主、语法合成信号、语法接收、语义接收），由同义映射 f_s、f_x 和逆映射 f_y^{-1} 进行桥接，并受四项失真约束：语法透明性、语义保真度、语法扰动和语义破坏。隐藏容量被建模为一个Stackelberg博弈，其中隐藏者先行动……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次为语义通信下的信息隐藏建立了信息论理论框架，将经典信息隐藏模型扩展为双层语义-语法结构，并在四项失真约束下以Stackelberg博弈形式刻画了隐藏容量。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first information-theoretic framework for information hiding in semantic communication, extending the classical hiding model to a two-layer semantic-syntactic structure with four distortion constraints and characterizing the hiding capacity as a Stackelberg game.
